title: Demon Biker Stasis
description: A red demonic figure with horns rides a flaming motorcycle directly out of a giant bloodshot eye toward the viewer. To the left, a large blue-toned screaming face with empty white eyes has red energy beams shooting from its mouth, while the background shows a dark city skyline with signs reading "JLX3" and the word "STASIS" above.
prompt: Surreal nightmare scene drawn on lined notebook paper, a muscular red demon with horns and evil grin aggressively rides a flaming motorcycle bursting out from inside a massive cracked bloodshot eyeball. To the left a giant blue screaming ghostly face with hollow eyes shoots red energy beams from its open mouth. Dark city skyline with glowing buildings and signs in the background, chaotic ink and marker art style with heavy linework.
medium: ink and marker on notebook paper
